newsitem.title: HONG KONG: UDL Holdings confirms KEL spin-off.
newsitem.headline: UDL Holdings confirms KEL spin-off.

text.p: UDL Holdings Ltd will list its wholly-owned subsidiary UDL Kenworth Engineering Holdings Ltd under the name KEL Holdings Ltd, the company said in a statement published on Monday.
UDL shareholders would be offered shares in KEL on the basis of one KEL share for every seven UDL shares held, the statement said.
The company said it plans to issue 100 million new KEL shares, representing 25 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of KEL.
The listing document setting out the details of the offer would be sent to shareholders on or about April 10, it said. Registration of UDL shareholders would be held from April 8-10.
The separate listing for KEL was conditional on approval of UDL shareholders. A special general meeting will be held on April 17 to vote on the spin-off.
UDL shareholders would also be asked to vote on the adoption of a share option scheme for KEL. No details of the scheme were given in the statement.
The new issue was expected to raise HK$100 million before expenses for KEL, the statement said.

KEL is engaged in the design, supply, installation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical engineering services and environmental engineering services such as waste water handling, water treatment and sewage treatment works.
UDL is engaged in the provision of marine engineering services, including shipbuilding and ship trading, contracting and civil engineering services, and structural steel works.
Amsteel Corporate Finance (H.K.) Ltd and UOB Asia Ltd are the sponsor and co-sponsor of the listing, the statement said.
